user.title: Set up an ESPeep scanner
user.description: Flash the ESPeep firmware with ESPHome and add the device to Home Assistant first. Then pick it here, together with the list scanned products should go on.

data.notify_service: Phone to ask for unknown products
data.include_brand: Put the brand in front of the name

data_description.device_id: The ESPHome device running the ESPeep firmware.
data_description.todo_entity: Any to-do list works: Local To-do, Shopping List, Bring!, Mealie, …
data_description.notify_service: A companion app notify service. You can type the name of a product nobody knows directly into the notification. Leave empty to get a Home Assistant notification instead.
data_description.online_lookup: Ask Open Food Facts, Open Products Facts and Open Beauty Facts. Results are cached in the product database, and your own names always win.
data_description.include_brand: "Ferrero Nutella" instead of "Nutella". Only applies to names from the online databases.
data_description.language: Two-letter code like "de". Empty uses the Home Assistant language.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up as an ESPeep scanner.

init.title: ESPeep settings
init.description: Barcodes and names are managed in the ESPeep panel in the sidebar.

data.notify_service: Phone to ask for unknown products
data.include_brand: Put the brand in front of the name

data_description.notify_service: Leave empty to get a Home Assistant notification instead.
data_description.language: Two-letter code like "de". Empty uses the Home Assistant language.

no_scanner.message: No matching ESPeep scanner is set up.

unknown_product.message: Barcode {ean} is not in the product database.

set_product.name: Set product
set_product.description: Stores a name for a barcode. It wins over anything the online databases say.

ean.name: Barcode
ean.description: EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or ITF-14, with a valid check digit.

name.name: Name
name.description: What goes on the shopping list.

remove_product.name: Remove product
remove_product.description: Forgets a product with all its barcodes. Given one of its further barcodes, only that one is removed.

add_barcode.name: Add barcode
add_barcode.description: Makes a barcode one more barcode of a product, e.g. the low-fat milk for "Milch". Scanning it puts the product's name on the list. A product stored under that barcode is merged in.

get_products.name: Get products
get_products.description: Returns the product database, the unknown barcodes and the recent scans.

scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Handles a barcode exactly as if it had been scanned — for testing without hardware.

device_id.name: Scanner
device_id.description: Which scanner's list and display to use. Defaults to the first one.
